scope:
Paired one-frame decider replays of live Lv 8 Deity frames (6 players, Small
Continents, Online), 2026-11-19 12:00Z to 11-20: the first captured frame of
each of the ten turns before 27 wars declared on us whose attacker was within
one gift's reach or read Friendly ("case" frames), and 120 ordinary frames
drawn with a fixed seed from 24 other games of the same window ("control").

`tribute-and-friendship-land` is the only bit that varies. Each arm is one
`civvis_orders --mirror DIR --explain --resumed` process built from the branch
(profile ci), with the run's own requested genome (why.log line 1 `forced`,
each as `--with`), `--victory` and `--civ`; the on arm adds `--with
tribute-and-friendship-land`. DIR holds the exact events.jsonl bytes the live
decider read for that frame (`decisions.jsonl` `input_capture`, the last
read).

Read per frame and arm: the orders (`payload`: the reply's turn, orders and
note; its `decision` block is left out); the tribute orders among them (`aid_gift`
verb `TRIBUTE`), the friendship orders, the delegation and embassy orders, and
the order list with those three kinds removed, which must be identical in the
two arms.

What this does NOT show. Each replay is a fresh agent and a fresh bridge: it
carries no memory of earlier frames, so the third change (a struck-out
friendship order is still sent) cannot show here: a fresh bridge has struck
nothing out. Whether a gift lands, an ask is accepted, or a war is avoided is
not measured: no frame is played forward and nothing is executed in Civ VI.
